mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation pressures ease.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that triggers central bank rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as policy easing expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of UNRATE > 5.5% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates coordinated economic slowdown and policy response, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as intervention expectations rise.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and FEDFUNDS fails to predict positive returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, industrial production below 105 signals manufacturing contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105 fails to predict negative returns in >60% of late-cycle periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 in 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: HOUST increases fail to predict positive returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105 periods produce positive returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS and RSAFS growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that delays monetary easing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as rate-hike expectations rise.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >60% of post-shock periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
